build_policy: jobs1; incremental disabled; target host warnings denied; no optimization override/global Rustflags; package-free C#
storage: Mounted network storage; normal output file I/O included in elapsed time

metrics.peak_rss_kib: GNU time -v whole measured-child maximum; startup/input/public call/JSON/writing included
metrics.boundary_vmrss_vmhwm_kib: Sparse current RSS/cumulative HWM at before-call/after-call/after-write; no phase peak attribution
metrics.time: Original GNUtime decimal seconds/wall spelling; coarse resolution

raw_originals: Complete files, typed outcomes, causes, proc/time originals, commands, exits and lifecycle retained separately by coordinator; public CSV is a portable transcription.
counter_caveat: GNU time wait4 child maximum and sparse self-proc VmRSS/VmHWM are distinct counters; 15 native rows have a boundary VmHWM above GNU time maximum; neither is normalized.
limits: Finite ASCII eager scalar workload, two repeats, ordinary dev/Debug, no phase/allocation attribution, no RAM ceiling, no release-build/streaming/massive-file generalization.
